comments.author: @LinhLe-w4r7l
comments.text: They showcase Saint Lucia’s iconic Pitons and luxury all-inclusive resorts for high-end tourists, but nobody films the steep, decaying wooden shacks in Soufrière where us elders sit in silence, watching our youth wither away as foreign investors turn our entire island into a private playground for the rich

replies.author: @ImpossibleTravel38
replies.text: I appreciate you taking the time to share these personal thoughts and experiences with me.

comments.author: @EarthsLastPlaces
comments.text: A drive-in volcano sitting right next to the Pitons is not something I had ever pictured in the Caribbean. Which of the two was more striking to see in person?

replies.author: @ImpossibleTravel38
replies.text: It’s hard to choose, but the dramatic volcanic spires of the Pitons are absolutely breathtaking to see in person! ❤️
